input.summary: Ported scan.cu to idiomatic SYCL 2020 in migrated/scan.dp.cpp. Changes from the SYCLomatic output: removed all dpct headers, helpers and DPCT macros; uses sycl::queue (in-order), sycl::malloc_device/memcpy/free, sycl::local_accessor for the __shared__ arrays, sycl::nd_range<1> launch with a grid-stride loop (16*compute units blocks of N/2=256 work-items), and sycl::group_barrier in place of __syncthreads. Both kernels' Blelloch logic is unchanged. The source compiles with icpx -fsycl with no dpct include (0 warnings). Verification: I ran the binary with the default 1048576 elements and compared both output halves (plain and bank-conflict-avoiding scan) against a CPU per-block exclusive scan of the same LCG input: 0 mismatches out of 2097152 float64 values, so the bar (atol=rtol=0) is met. grep finds no dpct/DPCT references. Kernel time on this device: ~246 ms for the timed loop (one repeat).
